options.title: A — Hai ngón cái
options.layout: RECOMMENDED BALANCED OPTION. Exploration: tiny profile top-left, compact 84px minimap top-right, Hành trang and Nhiệm vụ 52px buttons bottom-right; no bottom toolbar. Combat: two broad round LEFT/RIGHT buttons bottom-left; right thumb cluster in a compact curved fan with a large gold Đánh, Nhảy above-left, Lướt below-left, Giữ đỡ below, Linh trảm above, no overlaps. Inventory: top tabs 'Nhân vật' and active 'Túi đồ'; content left 62% item grid 5 columns x 3 visible rows and internal scroll, right 38% selected-item details, gold Trang bị button fixed below comparison. Profile/equipment is a separate internal tab, not a third squeezed column. Every screen emphasizes clear central world area.
options.prompt:
Create a polished UI DESIGN MOCKUP BOARD, not an actual gameplay screenshot, for the existing Vietnamese pixel-art RPG Trúc Khê being ported to Unity Android and iOS. Use the attached reference art faithfully: bright handheld pixel art, blue-robed black-haired chibi hero, vermilion roofs, green bamboo, cyan water; top-down exploration and separate SIDE-VIEW combat. Existing screenshots show the OLD DESKTOP UI which must be completely redesigned for a phone. Keep game art language, never keep oversized desktop panels. All options share dark jade panels, subtle warm gold edges, cream Vietnamese sans-serif labels, crisp legible icon silhouettes, restrained corners, no excessive decoration. No 3D rendering.

Output ONE tall portrait comparison board, ideally 1536x2560, with a concise heading and exactly THREE large LANDSCAPE phone screen designs stacked vertically: (1) KHÁM PHÁ, (2) CHIẾN ĐẤU, (3) HÀNH TRANG. Each screen same 844:390 aspect ratio, edge-to-edge game with thin border; NO bulky device chassis. Put screen captions OUTSIDE the game. Calm warm ivory board background and generous spacing. Each screen is a coherent finished design at the same scale, readable when viewed separately. At bottom a small tag "MOCKUP • CHƯA TRIỂN KHAI". Do not add extraneous screens, arrows over gameplay, annotation callouts or unrelated UI.

PHONE DESIGN REQUIREMENTS:
- Keep essential controls inside safe margins equivalent to 44 logical px at left/right and 20 at bottom; accommodate either landscape rotation. No interactive controls against the physical edge.
- Large finger targets, ideally 48–64 logical pixels, attack 72. Clearly separated controls with 8px gaps. Visible labels around 14–16px. Preserve central field of view.
- Exploration is TAP TO MOVE with a small destination ring; DO NOT invent joystick exploration. Compact profile (Vân Sinh / Cấp 1) upper left, small minimap upper right and map name attached, one Hành trang entry plus Nhiệm vụ and settings. No persistent quest tracking panel. No resource currencies, shop, ads, XP bar, auto combat or new progression systems.
- Combat shows hero on left and green bamboo snake on right with ground attack telegraph visible BETWEEN them, slim player bars (HP, TL, LL) and enemy name Trúc Diệp Xà / health at top, small pause. Exactly 7 distinct action controls: LEFT and RIGHT movement plus "Nhảy", "Lướt", "Giữ đỡ", "Đánh", "Linh trảm". NO keyboard labels A D J K L Space Shift. No encounter-charge counts or charge recharge countdown in combat. No map inventory button in combat. Show all 7 actions at usable sizes; make attack primary gold.
- Inventory is fully contained fullscreen with fixed close and fixed equip action. Single Hành trang entry from map; character/equipment/stats and bag are INSIDE it. Preserve 100 total slots and 10 equipment slots but show large visible subset with internal scrolling or pagination; NEVER squeeze 100 tiny slots on phone. Use real-looking green bamboo sword, robe, boots, jade pixel icons matching reference, no letters as item art. Selected item "Thanh Trúc Kiếm", "Cấp 3", "Công kích 21 → 27" (preview total after replacing existing sword), gold button "Trang bị", bag occupancy "10/100". No massive hero portrait. Only small relevant numbers and concise real UI labels, no lorem ipsum. Show a close button returning to map. Mockup values are illustrative, not new game rules.
The three screens must demonstrate the following specified option's genuinely different layout and interaction while retaining these common requirements.
